title: Air Station Elizabeth City rescues man from rooftop
description:
Coast Guard Petty Officer 2nd Class Darren Harrity, a rescue swimmer from Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina, saves a man who was stranded on his rooftop after Hurricane Florence, North Carolina, Sept. 17, 2018. Crews from Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina, Air Station Atlantic City, New Jersey, Air station Cape Cod, Massachusetts, Air Station Clearwater, Florida, and Air Station Savannah, Georgia supported the search and rescue efforts.
(U.S. Coast Guard photo by Petty Officer 3rd Class Ronald Hodges)
